details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically support the overall narrative of improved financial performance and strategic progress. There are no self-contradictions: profitability metrics (EBITDA loss narrowing, net loss decrease) align with revenue growth claims. Comparisons between years (2025 vs. 2024) are consistent throughout. Organizational structure flows logically from revenue growth to profitability, unit economics, strategic initiatives, and future outlook. While some metrics show mixed signals (e.g., churn increase vs. stable retention), these are presented as balanced insights rather than contradictions. No unnecessary repetition affects clarity. Segment figures (e.g., subscription fees, onboarding fees) are presented as contributing factors to total revenue without implying exhaustive additivity. The summary forms a clear, progressive narrative without internal logical gaps or contradictions.
